description: Replace the private feed link for one saved search owned by the authenticated workspace, immediately revoking its previous link. Requires explicit user intent. Does not delete the search or its events. Keep the replacement link private; a lost response may mean the link changed and cannot be recovered by listing searches.

id.description: Saved search UUID returned by create_saved_search or list_saved_searches, owned by this workspace.

name: rotate_saved_search_feed

feed_path.description: Replacement private capability path; the previous link is revoked.

title: Replace a saved search feed link
